statement: You are given a string s of lowercase letters and an integer k.
Count the substrings of s that contain exactly k distinct characters. Substrings are counted by position, so equal substrings at different places count separately.
A sliding window counts the substrings with at most k distinct characters in O(n) time. The answer is that count for k minus the same count for k − 1.

examples.explanation: The substrings with exactly two distinct letters are "pq" (twice), "qp", "pqp", "qpq", "pqpq" and "qs": 7 in all.
There are 21 substrings with at most 3 distinct letters and 13 with at most 2, so exactly 21 − 13 = 8 have three.
